EditInJournal.Name: Edit Pages in the Journal Editor
EditInJournal.Hint: When enabled, the edit button in the Subsystems window opens the page in the standard journal editor instead of the Page Builder form.

Research.Instructions: Track Research Points (RP) the PCs accumulate for each topic. Thresholds are indicated with markers, and the results of the PCs' research can be sent to chat (GM notes will be hidden).

Influence.Instructions: Track Influence Points (IP) the PCs accumulate for each NPC. Thresholds are indicated with markers, and the results of the PCs' influence can be sent to chat (GM notes will be hidden).

Reputation.Instructions: Track each faction's reputation. Tiers are marked on the slider, and completed locations each add +1.

Chases.Instructions: Each page is a chase. Headings after the title are obstacles, in order.
Chases.LengthHint: This chase has {count} obstacle(s). GM Core suggests 6 for a short chase, 8 for medium, or 10 for long.
Chases.ResetConfirm: Reset positions, Chase Points, and rounds to the start of this chase type?

Infiltration.Instructions: Each page is an infiltration. H2 headings with "Objective" start objectives; H3 headings under them are obstacles.
Infiltration.NoPartyHint: No party members found. Add the PCs to the party actor.
Infiltration.ClearForAll: Overcome for everyone at this objective
Infiltration.ResetConfirm: Reset objectives, awareness, rounds, and complications? Edge Points are kept.

Victory.Instructions: Each page is a victory point track. Bold lead-ins like 5 Victory Points set its thresholds.

Hacking.Instructions: Each page is a computer. Headings start access points; use Access, Vulnerability, Countermeasure (X Failures), Notice, Disable, Success, and Critical Success lead-ins.
Hacking.ResetConfirm: Reset successes, failures, vulnerabilities, countermeasures, and rounds for this computer?

Builder.RewriteWarning: Saving rewrites this page from the form. Text the form doesn't recognize is kept in Notes, but its position and any custom formatting are normalized.
Builder.NeedsName: Give the page a name before saving.
Builder.NoJournal: Select a journal for this subsystem first.
Builder.Name: Name
Builder.CheckGroupsHint: Each group is a bold label followed by its checks. A group labeled Discovery is never adjusted by weaknesses or resistances.
Builder.ModifiersHint: Write each one as a sentence. "by X" sets the amount (default 2); naming skills as checks ("Diplomacy checks") limits it to them. The line under each shows how it will be read.
Builder.ModifierPlaceholder: Flattery lowers the DC of Diplomacy checks by 2.
Builder.InfluenceThresholdsHint: What the PCs gain at each Influence total. Thresholds are sorted when you save.
Builder.ResearchGroupsHint: Each category is a bold label followed by its checks. Set a max to cap how many points that category can contribute.
Builder.ResearchThresholdsHint: What the PCs learn at each Research Point total. The highest is the topic's maximum.
Builder.MaxHint: Most points this category can contribute (leave blank for no cap)
Builder.VictoryGroupsHint: Groups of checks that earn Victory Points. (Group label is optional)
Builder.VictoryThresholdsHint: What happens at each Victory Point total. The highest is the track's maximum.
Builder.ReputationThresholdsHint: What each reputation tier means. Tiers are written top-down (Revered first) when you save.
Builder.LocationsHint: Each line adds +1 reputation when the GM marks it complete.
Builder.ObstaclesHint: In chase order. Leave Chase Points blank to use the party-size default.
Builder.OptionPlaceholder: A non-check way past this obstacle...
Builder.ObjectivesHint: In order. Each objective's obstacles are what PCs overcome to move past it.
Builder.RequiredHint: Obstacles a PC must clear to move on (blank = 1)
Builder.TriggerPlaceholder: The first time the PCs reach 5 AP...
Builder.AwarenessHint: Leave empty to use the default 5/10/15/20 thresholds. "DCs increase by X" (or naming skills) raises check DCs; mentioning failure ends the infiltration.
Builder.AccessPointsHint: Each access point is hacked separately. Hacking more than one, or getting double the successes on one, is a critical success.
Builder.SuccessesHint: Successes needed to hack this access point
Builder.MinDCHint: Vulnerabilities can't lower the Hack DC below this (optional)
Builder.VulnerabilityName: Vulnerability (e.g. Sticky note under the keyboard)
Builder.ReductionHint: How much exploiting this lowers the Hack DC
Builder.FailuresHint: Failures on this access point before it triggers
Builder.PersistentHint: Triggers again every round until disabled
Builder.DiscoveryHint: Undiscovered items are hidden from players until revealed
